verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a consumer AI assistant like Poke, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls, or any opt-out setting. The X-Poke-User-Id header and the 'Disconnect from Poke' integration control are related features, not telemetry opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
